description: Return the names of the providers `ask-all` WOULD dispatch for the current config + expert (enabled built-ins + eligible OpenRouter aliases, fanout cap applied), WITHOUT calling them. Use this to discover the panel, then issue one `ask-one` call per provider in parallel for visible per-provider progress. Pass `for: "consensus"` for the /consensus panel instead. `needsLogin` lists panel members with no login yet (codex on a fresh machine): run `codex-login` and let the user approve BEFORE dispatching, so they answer from the first call. No provider calls and never starts a login; when the dashboard journal is enabled (`dashboard.enabled`) it writes one local journal line opening a fan-out run and returns its `runId` - pass that to every `ask-one`. Returns a text-wrapped JSON envelope { providers[], omitted[], unavailable[], needsLogin[], runId? }.

cwd.description: Working directory the provider runs in (used to resolve relative file refs). Defaults to the server process directory.

expert.description: Optional persona to preview the panel for; affects which providers/aliases are eligible.

for.description: Which panel to echo: `ask-all` (default, fanout cap applied) or `consensus` (uncapped consensus delegates).

prompt.description: Optional: the question about to be fanned out. Recorded on the dashboard run only (when the dashboard journal is on); panel never sends it to a provider.

name: panel
